items.title: British counterterrorism police arrest US soldier accused of spying on behalf of Russia
items.summary: A member of the US Army has been arrested near Gloucester in England. Police said he was suspected of espionage activity in connection with Russia. Investigators from the US and UK are involved in the probe.

items.title: UK Privy Council overrules Trinidad and Tobago gay sex law
items.summary: A London court has overturned a Trinidad and Tobago law criminalizing consensual sexual relations between male same-sex couples. As a result of the colonial legacy, it is the independent country's last court of appeal.
